caption: The drawing features three antique keys, each depicted vertically and spaced evenly across a plain, light beige background. The keys are illustrated in a realistic manner, showing their metallic, dark brown coloration with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest their rounded and worn surfaces. Each key has a similarly shaped, rounded rectangular bow at the top, a long, cylindrical shaft with slight ornamental grooves and bulges near the center, and an intricate bit at the bottom. The keys decrease gradually in size from left to right, with the largest key on the left, the medium key in the middle, and the smallest key on the right. There is no additional scenery or decorative elements in the composition, and the only visible text is in the bottom right corner, reading “FEDERAL ART PROJECT WPA VA BY EDNA CLARK.”
title: Keys to John Marshall House
